# ============================================
# TEST CASES
# ============================================
def test_lru_cache():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    assert cache.get(1) == 1, "Test 1 Failed"
    cache.put(3, 3)  # 2 evicted
    assert cache.get(2) == -1, "Test 2 Failed"
    cache.put(4, 4)  # 1 evicted
    assert cache.get(1) == -1, "Test 3 Failed"
    assert cache.get(3) == 3, "Test 4 Failed"
    assert cache.get(4) == 4, "Test 5 Failed"
    print("LRU Cache: All tests passed!")

def test_min_heap():
    heap = MinHeap()
    heap.insert(5)
    heap.insert(3)
    heap.insert(8)
    heap.insert(1)
    assert heap.peek() == 1, "Test 1 Failed"
    assert heap.extract_min() == 1, "Test 2 Failed"
    assert heap.extract_min() == 3, "Test 3 Failed"
    assert heap.extract_min() == 5, "Test 4 Failed"
    assert heap.extract_min() == 8, "Test 5 Failed"

    heap2 = MinHeap()
    heap2.heapify([9, 4, 7, 1, 3, 6])
    assert heap2.extract_min() == 1, "Heapify Test 1 Failed"
    assert heap2.extract_min() == 3, "Heapify Test 2 Failed"
    print("MinHeap: All tests passed!")

def test_graph():
    g = Graph()
    for v in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]:
        g.add_vertex(v)
    g.add_edge(0, 1)
    g.add_edge(0, 2)
    g.add_edge(1, 3)
    g.add_edge(2, 3)
    g.add_edge(3, 4)

    bfs_result = g.bfs(0)
    assert 0 == bfs_result[0], "BFS Test 1 Failed"
    assert len(bfs_result) == 5, "BFS Test 2 Failed"

    dfs_result = g.dfs(0)
    assert 0 == dfs_result[0], "DFS Test 1 Failed"
    assert len(dfs_result) == 5, "DFS Test 2 Failed"

    path = g.shortest_path(0, 4)
    assert path[0] == 0 and path[-1] == 4, "Shortest Path Test Failed"
    assert len(path) == 3, "Shortest Path Length Test Failed"

    # Cycle detection (directed graph)
    dg = Graph(directed=True)
    for v in [0, 1, 2]:
        dg.add_vertex(v)
    dg.add_edge(0, 1)
    dg.add_edge(1, 2)
    dg.add_edge(2, 0)  # Cycle!
    assert dg.has_cycle() == True, "Cycle Test 1 Failed"

    dg2 = Graph(directed=True)
    for v in [0, 1, 2]:
        dg2.add_vertex(v)
    dg2.add_edge(0, 1)
    dg2.add_edge(1, 2)
    assert dg2.has_cycle() == False, "Cycle Test 2 Failed"

    print("Graph: All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_lru_cache()
    test_min_heap()
    test_graph()
